# Cam Currence

> Cam Currence (Cameron Currence, also known as Seven) is a photographer and AI engineer in Charlotte, North Carolina. Cam has photographed people in Charlotte for more than 8 years and builds AI agents and tools on Claude.

## Photography

- Portraits, fashion, and creative studio work, plus proposals, graduations, maternity, and other big days.
- Style, in Cam's words: "Bold, warm, and editorial. I love golden hour light, real moments, and shots that feel like a movie still."
- Portfolio and bookings: https://shotbyseven.com
- Photography Instagram: https://instagram.com/shotbyseven777

## AI journey

- 2016: Sold at Adidas and started a first online store, Y EverStop, and ran all of its marketing.
- 2022: Graduated from North Carolina A&T State University with a B.S. in Business, Entrepreneurship.
- 2023: Started FrontDeskLife, fitting AI tools into how small businesses already work.
- 2025: Built clawdis, an AI agent on Claude that runs day-to-day business work from a Telegram chat.
- 2025: Built CreatorGrowthAI, which audits social media profiles, scores them, and says what to fix.
- 2026: Launched SofarContent's free writing tools and plain-English guides to Claude.
- 2026: Opened a free sports picks chat on Telegram (21+, only where sports betting is legal).

## Projects

- [SofarContent](https://sofarcam.vercel.app): free AI tools that write hooks, captions, and post ideas.
- [Claude guides](https://sofarcam.vercel.app/guides): free, plain-English guides to using AI every day.
- [SofarSeven AI](https://discord.gg/sofarseven): Cam's AI community on Discord.
- [FrontDeskLife](https://frontdesklife.com): AI set up inside small businesses.
- [clawdis on GitHub](https://github.com/sofarcam): an AI agent that runs business work from Telegram.
